source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Assigning Roles (PDF 130, printed 126).

blocks.text: Wazeh roles har team member ko theek theek batate hain ke use kya karna hai. Ek shakhs research sambhal sakta hai, doosra maloomat munazzam kar sakta hai aur teesra aakhri presentation tayyar kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Chaar logon ki team poster bana rahi hai. Roles kaise baantein?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ki tarah: aik research kare, doosra maloomat tarteeb (organize) de, teesra final presentation tayyar kare, aur chautha maslan design ya checking kare. Har aik ko pata ho ke us ka kaam kya hai.

items: Wazeh roles: har member jaanta hai use kya karna hai.
